criterion_text: — Identity and failure safety. In controlled duplicate-name, invalid-input, metadata-write-failure, and kill/recreate interleavings, creation cannot silently succeed with missing requested metadata, mutate an existing/successor Session or destroy an unowned incarnation. Failure response/rollback follows the documented typed contract; no blind retry creates duplicate work.

verifiers.summary: Creation failure and re-creation never succeed with missing or foreign metadata

evidence.value: nession-agent at exact SHA 5cd4477378b8360cce2b9724dd989516b1e24ed2: a duplicate-name create with new metadata was refused and the live record stayed byte-identical; a forced metadata-write failure removed the new tmux Session and binding state so the same name was immediately retryable; a same-name recreation received its own revision-1 record while the previous incarnation was retained

verifiers.summary: Invalid input is refused before any Session side effect on the real route

evidence.value: nession-agent at exact SHA 5cd4477378b8360cce2b9724dd989516b1e24ed2: an agent.session.create with an over-limit title was answered with invalid_metadata before the Session backend, and the same name was creatable immediately afterwards
